## Synopsis

Replays spec/conformance/tier1 (embedded) against an arbitrary hook implementation
and scores it. Per case the command runs with STRAZA_HARNESS set and the payload on
stdin; {policy} in --cmd is replaced with the conformance PolicySet path.
Straza itself: --cmd "straza hook --conformance-policy {policy}"

```
strazactl spec conformance [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --cmd string     hook command under test ({policy} → conformance policy path)
      --suite string   conformance suite to run (default "hook-profile")
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
